turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, plus the new address.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.

I'm sorry, I can't change the address on SC-5209. The address can only be changed until the order ships, and this order was already delivered on 2026-11-18. Nothing has been changed. I can help with something else if you need it.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: I do not want a return. I only want the delivery address updated after delivery.

I understand, and I'm sorry. Under the shop rule, the delivery address can be changed only until the order ships. SC-5209 has already been delivered, so I can't update the address, and nothing has been changed. If you'd like a colleague to look at it, tell me and I'll pass it on.
